## Guía de funciones en R para regresión múltiple

<div class="block-definition fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title" style="font-size: 28px;">Análisis completo paso a paso</div>
  <div class="block-body">
  <p class="text-justify" style="font-size: 28px;">
  Esta rutina cubre: exploración, ajuste, evaluación, selección y diagnóstico. Los resultados se presentan con tablas para mantener la salida limpia y pedagógica.
  </p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="3">

<table style="width:100%; font-size: 25px; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;">
<thead>
<tr style="background-color: #1b4d2e; color: white;">
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 8%;">Paso</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 22%;">Etapa</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 50%;">Funciones en R</th>
<th style="padding: 10px 14px; width: 20%;">Librería externa</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">1</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Exploración</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>cor()</code>, <code>plot()</code>, <code>ggpairs()</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>GGally</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">2</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Estimación</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>lm(Y ~ X1 + X2 + factor(X3), data = datos)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">3</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Evaluación</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>summary(modelo)</code>, <code>confint(modelo)</code>, <code>vif(modelo)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>car</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">4</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Selección</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>step(modelo, direction = "forward/backward/both")</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr class="bb-slate200">
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">5</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Diagnóstico gráfico</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>par(mfrow = c(2, 2))</code> + <code>plot(modelo)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14">,</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="pad-8-14 text-center text-bold text-block-green">6</td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><strong>Diagnóstico numérico</strong></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>shapiro.test(residuals)</code>, <code>bptest(modelo)</code>, <code>durbinWatsonTest(modelo)</code></td>
<td class="pad-8-14"><code>lmtest</code>, <code>car</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>
